metric: next-30-game EV stint MSE of the attacking side xG/60 (lower is better), players fixed at the as-of ratings, covariates refit on the test rows; gain = MSE(covariates only) - MSE(model)

selection.rule: the candidate (recency x shrinkage) with the lowest pooled tuning-season primary MSE wins; if the best block-weight candidate is within one paired SE of the overall best, the block candidate is chosen (the owner's lead form). Dev and holdout are reported for the chosen candidate, the benchmarks and the best candidate of every recency, never used to re-select
